accuracy: Zero absolute logit/action difference in every paired shape. Final cached implementation passed the actual Julia question/action production reference in cargo test --workspace.
policy: Fused CPU projection/optional bias/exact GeGLU at >=16 trailing columns. One runtime-local expanded projection scratch buffer; outputs own independent buffers. Shorter CPU inputs retain the original GEMM/GeGLU sequence. Other backends retain native composition.
limitations: Initial pairs had no scratch cache or short-sequence threshold. paired-cached.json tests the final cache/threshold candidate. Short-shape differences there use identical operations and represent variation. No claim of beating Python; Python L64 about134.5ms versus candidate about178.5ms.
reproduce: Apply diagnostic.patch to base revision and run bench_paired_fused_mlp in release, RAYON_NUM_THREADS=8, with local checkpoint. Diagnostic switch is removed in production source.
